tierReason: One cycle from the MVP epic; adds idea, vote and idea-comment tables and API endpoints

decisions.decision: #11: ideas get their own comment, photo, label-join and vote tables rather than generalising task ones
decisions.why: Task tables are coupled to task permissions and reminders; parallel copies keep #8/#9 untouched

decisions.decision: #11: any member changes status; author and Owner edit, delete and manage photos
decisions.why: Mockup assumption 3, user did not object

decisions.decision: #11: order by score then newest; one anonymous vote per member, own idea allowed
#11: one task per idea, created on the server with photos copied to new Cloudinary ids
decisions.why: Shared public ids would be destroyed when either side is deleted

decisions.decision: #11: generalise mobile comments and photos components to a parent adapter instead of copying
decisions.why: Keeps one design and avoids ~24 duplicated files; existing tests guard tasks

decisions.decision: #11: no photo copy when creating a task from an idea
decisions.why: User's answer 2026-11-18; tracked as a follow-up ticket

questions.question: #11: Confirm the mockup assumptions (order by score; one anonymous vote; any member changes status; author+Owner edit/delete; no bell on idea comments; one task per idea)?
#11: Should creating a task from an idea copy its photos? It needs new server-side Cloudinary copy code and uses storage twice. Default in the spec: yes.
questions.answer: Not for now; note it and add a ticket to the board

findings.text: apps/api/src/ideas/photos.ts:220: a 403 from canManage on the record route leaves orphaned=false, so an already-uploaded image stays in Cloudinary (needs a hand-crafted call, sign already 403s). Fix: mark orphaned before pre-create failures.
apps/api/src/ideas/photos.ts:100-121: after the idea is deleted, requireIdeaOrDestroyUpload destroys the server-fixed image path on the caller's say-so (harmless, note only).
apps/api/src/ideas/routes.ts:219-247: image destroy after commit is not awaited; a crash in between orphans images (same trade-off as tasks).
apps/api/src/ideas/routes.ts:109: idempotent re-create returns the existing idea ignoring a differing body (task convention).

Mockup 2d departure: the task-from-idea form shows title, description and labels read-only, without the Giao cho and Hạn chót fields in the mockup, because the API only takes { taskId }; the user sets them on the new task after it opens.
User decision 2026-11-18: the task-from-idea form must include Giao cho and Hạn chót as in mockup 2d (POST /ideas/:ideaId/task to accept assigneeIds and due).

apps/api/src/ideas/photos.ts ~225-230: orphaned=true before the 403 runs before the existing-photo check, so a non-manager member re-recording an existing photo id (public id is computable) gets 403 and the catch destroys the author's real image while the row stays. Only mark orphaned when no IdeaPhoto row with body.id exists.
ideas/routes.ts and photos.ts: awaited destroyImages has no visible timeout; a hanging Cloudinary call holds the delete request.

testHandoff.steps: Run npm run dev:phone from this branch checkout (after db:deploy on the dev DB), open in Expo Go, sign in as an Owner and, on another phone, as a member of the same project. 1) Project screen: Ý tưởng tile enabled with 'n mới' (mockup 1a). 2) Ideas list: highest score first, then newest; Đã bỏ collapsed at the end; status and label filters; empty, loading, and error with Thử lại when the API is stopped (1b-1d). 3) Idea screen, status sheet, vote buttons, Sửa only for author and Owner, comments without bells (2a, 2b). 4) Set an idea to Đã chọn, tap Tạo công việc từ ý tưởng: the form shows title, description and labels read-only (no Giao cho or Hạn chót, a known departure from mockup 2d); Tạo công việc opens the new task; back returns to the idea, which shows Đã tạo công việc (2e); the task shows Từ ý tưởng. 5) New and edit forms, delete confirm (3a-3b). 6) Airplane mode: create, edit, vote show Chờ lưu and sync after reconnect (3c). 7) Dark mode, English, VoiceOver on vote buttons (3d). 8) Recheck task comments and photos still work as before (shared components were refactored). Expected: all match the mockup, selections highlighted with no ticks.
